ABANDON REASON! KNOW ONLY WAR!
FILTHY XENOS!
♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ HERETICS!

For real though, this game is pretty great. 
The campaign's story can be considered forgetable, but the gameplay and combat is glorious, hacking, slashing, crushing, and shooting through hordes of xenos scum. 
Along with this, the game boasts a pretty decent multiplayer mode. 
Although the playerbase is relatively small, matches can still be (heretically) chaotic and pretty damn fun.

Thank you Humble Bundle for providing this copy.
Now I'm off to PURGE.

Exactly what it looks like, a 3P shooter/fighter that's fairly arcade-y, but satisfying and frustrating in turns. Very 'souls-lite' play. Not a ton of weapon options, but a lot of Warhammer 40K visuals and unlockable content (which is why we're all here. ) for *multiplayer* chars. There are a few viable playstyles which should broaden the appeal , and there are people playing mutiplayer right now because it was just free for a few weeks. I played 15 hours worth of single player to beat the game on Normie, and an hour or two of multiplayer. This game is probably worth $10, I got it for free and enjoyed my 15 hours enough to write this review.

Machines for the Machine God? I don't know how this works.

an amazing game.  my dad got it on this account years ago when it was more new and he beat the game before i was really into anything but the first dawn of war, and now that it's free the playerbase has been revived!  i gave it another go and wowza was i missing out.  the campaign is very fun, and the melee combat is enjoyable albeit easy.  the gunplay is fun and challenging, and the two multiplayer gamemodes are great.  i've rarely seen bugged lobbies, and the customization is great, especially the grind to get armour
I can't recommend this game because controls are unresponsive and clunky. It takes away the fun.
One of the best free games I've played in Steam
